paragraphs.text: That is, govern and dispose all things pertaining to the family.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: The public estate of the commonwealth.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Who watch and ward and are also magistrates and rulers of the city.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: Either that which is gained by hard labour, or eaten with grief of mind.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Not exempting them from labour, but making their labours comfortable and as it were a rest.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: That is, endued with strength and virtues from God: for these are signs of God's blessings, and not the number.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: Such children will be able to stop their adversaries mouths, when their godly life is maliciously accused before judges.
paragraphs.label: g
